dedupe_keys.name: usepe project scenarios dataset u space drone traffic separation simulations for bluesky

description: This dataset holds the scenario files, input data and raw outputs of the simulation exercises of USEPE (U-space Separation in Europe), a Horizon 2020 project on separation management for drones in urban airspace. Three exercises are included, last-mile delivery, emergency services and urban surveillance, each in reference and solution form for the project's density-based separation concept (D2C2); every exercise has a settings file, a data folder, BlueSky scenario files and the outputs obtained in the project, and a slide guide explains how to rebuild runnable scenarios with the USEPE plugin for the BlueSky air traffic simulator. It was published on Zenodo on 12 May 2023 by researchers of Nommon, Indra Navia and the German Aerospace Center (DLR), with European Commission funding under grant 890378. Coverage is urban airspace scenarios of the project. The four ZIP archives (30 to 93 MB) and the guide are free to download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: some input data are left out because of size or property restrictions, so not every scenario runs as shipped; the plugin must be obtained separately; and the project ended with this release. The data support capacity planning, emergency response and agent-based studies of drone traffic in cities, and run in the BlueSky simulator catalogued here.
